facts.what: 一个男人要领养 Johnny，Sarah 手脚紧紧缠住这位寄养哥哥（foster brother）的脖子和躯干，不肯放手。
facts.anchor: My arms and legs wrapped around the tight cords of my foster brother’s neck and torso.

facts.what: Johnny 嘱咐 Sarah 保持坚强：继续做个 badass bitch，打拼回他身边来。
facts.anchor: You keep being a badass bitch and fight your way back to me.

facts.what: Ethan 上前把 Sarah 从 Gage 手里接过来抱紧，看着 Johnny 上车时愤怒低声发誓：我们一定会找到他，我不在乎用什么办法。
facts.anchor: I swear to fuck we’ll find him. I don’t care how. We will. I swear it to you.

facts.what: Ethan 童年时火灾几乎夺命留下的疤痕（他视为畸形、不许人碰），这次任由 Sarah 把脸贴在他脖子的疤痕皮肤上。
facts.anchor: the damage from the fire that nearly took his life as a boy

facts.what: Misfits 是 Johnny 的前女友给这群人起的称呼；Ethan 的伤疤在这群人里被看作力量而非弱点。
facts.anchor: holding that part of himself from the rest of us Misfits—what Johnny’s ex-girlfriend called us—wasn’t needed

facts.what: Sarah 盘点一个月内接连失去的人：先是 Baby Blue，再是她的 Caleb，现在又是 Johnny。
facts.anchor: First with Baby Blue. Then my Caleb. Now Johnny? All within a month?

facts.what: 领养 Johnny 的人名叫 Styx——一个 Johnny 认识、会在噩梦里为之哭喊的名字。
facts.anchor: Styx. A name Johnny knew and would cry for in his nightmares.

facts.what: 淋浴水泛出闪烁光点，Sarah 和 Ethan 都看得见；Ethan 断定这与血誓（blood oath）有关，并追问 Johnny 是否早知道会这样。
facts.anchor: Ethan jolted, then looked at his bandaged hand. “Holy shit… You’re right. But why?
